title: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5, Its Most Powerful AI Yet, With Cyber Safeguards
summary: On June 9, Anthropic released Claude Fable 5, the most capable model it has ever made, generally available. It also did something unusual: it shipped one model as two products, split not by capability but by a layer of safety classifiers.
